news.name: Frost Resistance Gear & More Argent Dawn Reputation Rewards Now Available - Classic Anniversary
news.pinDescription: The Argent Dawn is fighting back the Scourge, and you can earn new rewards by helping them right now! You can collect [item=22523] and [item=22524] and turn them in for powerful rewards. If you're a crafter you can also learn new Frost Resistance recipes, like [item=22686] and [item=22703].

news.name: How To Get Attuned to Naxxramas - Argent Dawn Reputation, Materials, & Gold Cost
news.pinDescription: Classic Anniversary Phase 6 launches on October 2nd; here's how to start the attunement process for the upcoming Naxxramas raid!

news.name: Argent Dawn Reputation in Season of Discovery Phase 7
news.pinDescription: Season of Discovery Phase 7 is here, and while we can't quite get into Naxxramas yet, we can start preparing by earning Reputation with the Argent Dawn!

news.name: Seal of Dawn Trinkets in Season of Discovery - Rank System with Argent Dawn for Buffs in Naxxramas
news.pinDescription: Blizzard has updated the Phase 7 PTR for Season of Discovery with new Seal of Dawn trinkets updates. They've expanded on the system reported on [url=https://www.wowhead.com/classic/news/new-argent-dawn-reputation-trinkets-season-of-discovery-phase-7-ptr-354959]the previous PTR update[/url]. The system now has Ranks, giving players tremendous power with each step.

news.name: New Argent Dawn Reputation Trinkets - Season of Discovery Phase 7 PTR
news.pinDescription: Datamining for the Season of Discovery Phase 7 PTR is in full swing, and we've found some interesting new trinkets - it looks like the Argent Dawn reputation will be gaining a few more rewards!

news.name: New Argent Dawn Reputation Item Datamined - Season of Discovery Phase 6 PTR
news.pinDescription: As we approach Season of Discovery Phase 6, we have datamined a new item of interest for players looking to increase their Argent Dawn reputation.

news.name: All Costs to Upgrade Argent Dawn Reputation Epics in Season of Discovery Phase 4

news.name: How To Get Attuned to Wow Classic Naxxramas - Argent Dawn Rep, Materials, Gold
news.pinDescription: The release date has been announced for WoW Classic Naxxramas--December 3rd. You'll be able to get attuned to Naxx with the content unlock, but there are things you can do in advance to prepare for the attunement.

news.name: Most Classic Timbermaw Hold and Argent Dawn Reputation Rewards Not Coming in Phase 1
news.pinDescription: Most Argent Dawn and Timbermaw Hold recipes are not available in Phase 1 of Classic WoW. As players have hit level 60 and worked on grinding reputation, we've been able to confirm which recipes are available from the quartermasters.

database.name: Argent Dawn
database.pinDescription: The Argent Dawn were an organization focused on protecting Azeroth from the threats that seek to destroy it, such as the Burning Legion and the Scourge. Since the Shattering of Azeroth, the Argent Dawn have been merged by Tirion Fordring with his Knights of the Silver Hand, forming a new faction, the Argent Crusade. As a result, all previous means of gaining reputation with the faction have been removed.
